title: Small words: dA, bile, ki, ya
summary: Use the small words that give spoken Turkish its colour: *dA* beyond **too** (*Gel de gör*, *O kadar da zor değil*), *bile* for **even** and **already**, the conjunction *ki* (*öyle yorgunum ki…*, *dedi ki*), *ya* (*Biliyorsun ya*, *ya … ya*), and *hani*, *işte*, *acaba*, *sakın*, *bari* and *hele*.
canDo: Stress, contrast and soften with dA and bile: Teşekkür bile etmedi, O kadar da kötü değil
Say that something was so … that, with ki
Remind, insist and offer two choices with ya and ya … ya
Reproach, warn and settle for less with hani, sakın and bari
